correctness.rationale: For supports of at least three points, the full trace restricts every coordinate to at most two symbols; the co-singleton traces force a distinct private coordinate per member, and conversely private-coordinate choices realize every trace. All pairs are shattered, 216 triples arise from eight parity triples in each of the 27 unique binary boxes, and no four-support exists. Both standalone, independently implemented exact programs enumerate all supports of size at most four, verify maximal edges, and compute GF(2) boundary rank 133, giving reduced Betti ranks 192 and 83.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial three-coordinate ternary antipodal-sphere set system admits a complete, geometrically described shattered complex rather than merely a known VC dimension. Its full edge skeleton, 216 parity triangles, 189 maximal edges and independently checked two-degree mod-two homology provide a natural sharp topological boundary example and a reproducible comparison object for incidence-complex research.
